A '''comm-relay''' was a device used to communicate over long distances. [[Talon Karrde]] carried one when he went on a [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]]-hunting [[Gamgalon's Morodin-hunting safari|safari]] on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. It was hidden within his [[Melodium/Legends|melodium]].
